wholePhysicalScope: Six named native building footprints within the hotel’s main parcel locate the surviving historic and newer structures. Unflattened national GSI DEM5A relief positions the different foundation datums on the slope.
lodDetails: Four authored levels preserve all six hillside envelopes and the distinct Main, Flower Palace and Dining Room rooflines.
limitations: Six principal buildings are modeled in the main compound. The detached Kikka-so across the road, shops, interior fittings and small garden structures are outside scope.

The discrete building datums follow the national elevation survey. Retaining walls, courtyard steps and interpolated ground beneath the buildings are approximations.
